profile.headline: Principal Engineer / Technical Leadership
profile.summary:
I am a dedicated problem solver who enjoys taking on the responsibility of addressing the most difficult and sensitive business problems.  Relying on my diverse experiences, I can apply both time-tested and innovative technological solutions depending on the business need.  I also know where my expertise ends and the expertise of others begins so I am keenly aware of how best to utilize the talent on my teams.   Leadership must be tailored to each individual uniquely, as it is not a "one style fits all" endeavor.  This allows me to effectively mentor and inspire developers and I take great pride in this.  I believe this allows any team I’m on to operate at a highly efficient level.

Areas of expertise:
Application Observability/Telemetry | Load testing | Re-architecting legacy applications (Monoliths to Microservices) | Distributed, Fault-Tolerant System design | REST API design | Real-time data processing (time series, event sourcing) | Platform Engineering | Event-Driven Processing | Batch Processing | 3rd Party Integrations | Caching and Performance Tuning | Cloud-native development | Application Profiling (JVM heap analysis) | Database design (RDBMS, NoSQL) | A/B testing

positions.description: Skills: Telemetry · Datadog · Azure Functions · Azure Containers · Azure Storage · Observability

positions.title: Principal Engineer / Engineering Manager
positions.description:
I was the original application architect and engineer on MediaPlatform's next-generation enterprise video streaming application and took it from proof-of-concept all the way to a revenue-generating production application.  Along the way, I built the team with which I supported the application.

Technologies Used: 
Java, Reactive (Akka), Spring stack, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Docker, DataDog, Kubernetes, Wowza (streaming video engine), HLS video, Amazon AWS: EC2, ECS, S3, SQS, SNS, SES, Kinesis (for time-series analytics data), Websockets, OpenSearch, CloudFront (CDN), Event-driven Messaging. Event Sourcing
positions.insights: Skills: Cloud Computing · NoSQL · MongoDB · Redis · Docker Products · Datadog · Telemetry · Observability

positions.title: Software Architect / Tech Lead
positions.description:
ChromeRiver is an expense and invoice reporting SAAS application that made heavy use of a rules engine for customizing each client's workflows.  They hired me to lead the re-architecture of their legacy system to a more modern technological stack to improve system scalability, developer productivity, and developer retention.  

Technologies:
The new tech stack included creating Microservices with Spring Boot (converting a monolith), Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Integration, Drools (Rules Engine), Docker, New Relic, Mule ESB, MongoDB, Memcached, AWS (S3, SQS, EC2), ActiveMQ, Gradle, and Jenkins.
positions.insights: Skills: Rules Engines · MongoDB · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Docker Products · Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) Architecture

positions.title: Senior Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Brighter.com was a startup website that allowed users to find a dentist and receive discounts on dental services.  The business model was a freemium model where free, “one-off” vouchers with small discounts will lead to paid memberships with larger discounts. 

Technologies:
Spring stack, Tomcat, Memcached, Solr (Lucene), Amazon S3, Cloudfront CDN, 3rd party payment processing integration, A/B testing, batch processing, and MySQL
positions.insights: Skills: Solr · A/B Testing · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · linode · Payment Card Processing

positions.title: Personal goal pursuit
positions.description:
Decided to take some time off to travel a bit and play poker tournaments.  Had good success with both endeavors.  https://pokerdb.thehendonmob.com/player.php?a=r&n=48680

Also picked up some contract work for a few months.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Business.com was a vertical search engine that had a cost-per-click business model.  The CRM system is where Business.com advertisers went to manage all aspects of their campaigns including adding new search keywords, listings (keyword groups), budgeting, and credit card information.   I also refactored the batch-processing services responsible for all revenue generation to improve reliability, testing and scalability.

Technologies:
The system jointly resided on a cluster of JBoss (Linux) servers and Resin (Windows) servers and used JBoss web services (SOAP), JMS, Struts, EJBs, Hudson, a SQLServer database and a custom java batch process framework.  A refactor of portions of the CRM system was later done using Spring, SpringMVC, JUnit, iBatis, and Spring Batch
positions.insights: Skills: 3rd Party Integrations · Messaging · Batch Processing · Microsoft SQL Server · Payment Card Processing

positions.title: Software Application Architect
positions.description:
Pearson's "Lesson Lab" was an innovative online resource for educators to improve their teaching methods.  It used video, content, and collaboration.  I was hired to port a legacy Lotus Domino/Windows application to an open-source architecture.  I was the lead Technical Architect responsible for all aspects of designing the network and software architectures as well as leading the development team.  The legacy application development team had no prior Java or Open-Source experience.

Technologies:
JBoss, Servlets, Struts, JMS, EJBs, XML, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Red Hat Linux, JMS messaging
positions.insights: Skills: Mentoring · Teaching · Database Design · Network Architecture

positions.title: Software Engineer / Tech Team Leader
positions.description:
Developed major pieces of the cart, inventory and credit card processing functionality for Eastbay.com, Footlocker.com, and NFLShop.com.  

Technologies: 
3rd-party integration for inventory and payment processing, J2EE components (JSP, Servlets and EJBs), ColdFusion, and a Sybase database.  A Batch Processing framework also ran Java stand-alone applications on Solaris UNIX.

Technologies: ColdFusion, Sybase
